question: Related Questions Q. Use of echo in Mike for salaah 2935 views Q. Performing two sajdah after taravih and reading “سبوح، قدوس، رب الملائكة والروح” ten times with Ayatul Kursi 4202 views Q. If namaz is performed behind emmam and after emmam completes the prayer ,and any body praying behind him who reached late and got only 1 rakat then he will complete the rakats left ,in this left rakats if he does mistake, does he need to do sizda sahoo? 2227 views Q. Should my prayers be shortened or done in full? 3246 views Q. Salah 1647 views Q. I am a 33 year old Indian male from Mumbai, staying in workig in Abu Dhabi. I have pproximately 20-22 years of Qada namaz. I came across a site called www.islamicacademy.com giving the following easy way of praying For the people who have many years of missed Salahs. There is a way to pray them quickly. Following instructions have four exeptions and has all Fards and Wajibs for a complete Salat. Please pray your Qaza as soon as possible. Even of you could pray one days Qaza Salahs every day which are only 20 rakahs (3 wajib witr), please do it. It only takes few mins to perform 20 rakahs according to the following instructions. 1) In Ruku and Sajdah instead of reciting "Subhaana Rabbiyal Azeem" and "Subhaana Rabbiyal A'la" three times, say it only once. But make sure do not leave Ruku poster untill the Meem (M) of Azeem has been said properly. Similarly do not leave the posture of Sajdah until Ala has been said completely. Just make sure to say these Tasbeehaat properly and do not rush. 2) In third and four Rakah of Fard Salah instead of reciting the whole Soorah Fatiha say, "Subhan Allah" three times and go to Ruku, . Make sure "Subhan Allah" has been recited three times properly, do not rush. This exeption is only for Fard. In third rakah of Witr it's a must to recite full Soorah Fatiha followed by at least three ayahs of Quran or a soorah (as we usually do in first and second rakah). 3) In last Qaidah (when we sit for Attahyyat) before Salam, after Attahyyat instead of full Durood and Dua just say, "Allah Humma Salle Ala Sayedena Mohammad Wa Aalihi", then finish the Salat with Salam. Dua is not a must here. 4) In Witr, instead of full Dua-e-Qunoot just say "Rabbigh Fir Lee" one or three times. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 32789 Country: Pakistan Title: Namaz while traveling train and flight Question: My question is that if i am travelling in a train or a flight in which direction i have to offere namaz? Considering that i do not have any idea of the Qiblah's direction. Answer ID: 32789 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1069/1070/M=1432) Salah is offered facing Qiblah direction though one is travelling by train or plane. It is a condition in salah to turn towards Qiblah direction. If one has no knowledge about Qiblah and does not carry compass with him, then one should guess Qiblah direction during daytime by watching the sun and if it is night or it is daytime but the sun is invisible then one should imply other sings and indications with full deliberation. Then, he should perform salah facing the direction to which his heart tends. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
